name: Truc Lam Phuong Nam
nameVi: Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam
kicker: Zen monastery on the Phong Điền road
summary: Large Zen monastery of tiled halls on nearly 4 ha: walk its courts on your Phong Điền orchard loop. It is the largest Zen monastery in the delta, built in the Lý–Trần style with timber columns and tiled roofs. It stands a few hundred metres from Mỹ Khánh, about 15 km from the centre. Go in the daytime, after the morning boats.
getThere: With Mỹ Khánh, about 15 km from the centre
heroCaption: Tiled halls and the court at Trúc Lâm Phương Nam
body: Thiền viện Trúc Lâm Phương Nam covers nearly 4 ha and is the largest Zen monastery in the delta. The halls follow the Lý–Trần style, with timber columns, tiled roofs, and floors of ship tiles.
The monastery is on đường Mỹ Nhơn, a few hundred metres from Mỹ Khánh village and about 15 km from the centre. Pair the two on the same road, after the dawn boats.

gettingThere: The monastery is on đường Mỹ Nhơn in phường An Bình, about 15 km from the centre and a few hundred metres from Mỹ Khánh.

legs.heading: From Ninh Kiều
legs.body: By car or motorbike toward Phong Điền, about 15 km.

legs.heading: From Mỹ Khánh
legs.body: A few hundred metres along the same road.
